headline: US Excludes South Africa from G20 Leaders Summit Invitation List
summary: The US presidency's G20 website lists Poland but excludes South Africa from invitations to the December leaders' summit in Miami, raising trade questions.
why: South Africa is the only permanent African member of the G20; exclusion highlights diplomatic tensions with Washington that could impact trade preferences under AGOA.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Diplomatic exclusion creates uncertainty over bilateral US trade agreements and foreign capital inflows.
